title_sq: Apartament 2+1+2 per shitje tek Shkolla e Bashkuar!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 tek Shkolla e Bashkuar!
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje godine te re te sapo ndertuar. Ndodhet ne katin e 7. Apartamenti organizohet nga nje korridor shperndares, 1 salle ndenjeje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, 1 ballkon dhe 1 garderobe e vecuar ne dhomen matrimoniale. 
Apartamenti ka nje mobilim modern dhe teper komod. 
Zona ku ky apartament ndodhet ofron te gjitha facilitetet e mundeshme per nje jetese sa me komode si supermarkete, bare, restorante, shkolla, spitale, etj.
Per me shume informancione me kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale at the United School!
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale at the United School! The apartment is located in a newly built building. It is located on the 7th floor. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, 1 living room together with the kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1 balcony and 1 separate wardrobe in the master bedroom. The apartment has a modern and very comfortable furniture. The area where this apartment is located offers all possible facilities for a comfortable life such as supermarkets, bars, restaurants, schools, hospitals, etc. For more information, contact me!
